python:
import collections,datetime,json,pathlib,pickle,sqlite3,subprocess
from mappa.mappa_core.core.scheduler.bundles import Blob,read_blob
root=pathlib.Path("private-reference-9c4f5e5ebc9c06f88f0c")
if not (root/"1/result/verification-completion.json").exists():
    print("Verification remains active")
    print((root/"verify-21135583.log").read_text()[-2000:])
    raise SystemExit(2)
counts=collections.Counter()
directions={}
metrics={}
failures=[]
for batch in range(5):
    db=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{root/batch.__str__()}/result/ledger.sqlite?mode=ro",uri=True)
    for name,stage,state,reference,audit,error in db.execute("select * from results"):
        counts[(stage,state)]+=1
        if stage=="matching":
            continue
        m=metrics.setdefault(stage,dict(tasks=0,cpu_seconds=0.,compute_cpu_seconds=0.,peak_sampled_worker_rss_bytes=0,peak_process_lifetime_rss_bytes=0))
        record=read_blob(Blob(**json.loads(audit)),None)
        for task in record["tasks"]:
            result=pickle.loads(task[-1]) if task[-1] else {}
            m["tasks"]+=1
            m["cpu_seconds"]+=result.get("total_cpu_seconds",result.get("sampled_cpu_seconds",0.))
            m["compute_cpu_seconds"]+=result.get("cpu_seconds",0.)
            m["peak_sampled_worker_rss_bytes"]=max(m["peak_sampled_worker_rss_bytes"],result.get("peak_tree_rss_bytes",0))
            m["peak_process_lifetime_rss_bytes"]=max(m["peak_process_lifetime_rss_bytes"],result.get("process_lifetime_peak_rss_bytes",0))
            if state!="complete":
                failures.append(dict(case=name,stage=stage,state=state,error=error,audit=json.loads(audit),
                    metrics={k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!="blob"}))
        if stage=="verification":
            directions[name]=read_blob(Blob(**json.loads(reference)),None)["status"] if state=="complete" else "error"
    db.close()
cases=[]
for case in range(1851):
    forward=directions.get(f"{case:05d}/forward","missing")
    reverse=directions.get(f"{case:05d}/reverse","missing")
    status="recovered" if "recovered" in (forward,reverse) else (
        "not_recovered" if forward==reverse=="not_recovered" else "unknown")
    cases.append(dict(case=case,forward=forward,reverse=reverse,status=status))
summary=dict(observed_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    counts=[dict(stage=stage,state=state,count=n) for (stage,state),n in sorted(counts.items())],
    reference_directions=dict(collections.Counter(directions.values())),
    reference_reactions=dict(collections.Counter(row["status"] for row in cases)),
    stage_metrics=metrics,failures=failures,
    fresh_decoder_retry=json.loads((root/"fresh-decoder-1561-forward/status.json").read_text()),
    independent_verification=json.loads((root/"1/result/verification-completion.json").read_text()),
    slurm_accounting=subprocess.check_output(["sacct","-X","-j","21135189,21135190,21135465,21135583",
        "--format=JobID,State,ExitCode,Start,End,Elapsed,AllocCPUS","-P"],text=True).splitlines())
(root/"results-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+"\n")
(root/"reference-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(cases,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
